description: This file defines a Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' that implements the 'LogNode' interface. It acts as a filter for logging, passing on only the message without metadata, suitable for on-screen logs where simplicity is preferred.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter node in the logging pipeline that filters logs to only pass the message content.

methods.description: Constructor that takes the next LogNode in the chain for chaining logs.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message, passing only the message to the next LogNode.

methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.
